# AABB_on_atoms { #mofography.compute.AABB_on_atoms }

```python
compute.AABB_on_atoms(ase_atoms, points=None)
```

Build a freud AABBQuery neighbor tree for an ASE structure and optional query points.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type   | Description                | Default    |
|-----------|--------|----------------------------|------------|
| ase_atoms |        | ASE atoms object           | _required_ |
| points    |        | the positions of the atoms | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description   |
|--------|--------|---------------|
|        |        | The AABB tree |
